mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and encouraging equity investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in rate hike episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 for two consecutive months signals weak labor demand, lowering equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in slack episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 150,000 for three consecutive months indicates strengthening labor demand, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d forward returns in strengthening episodes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 102.5 signals robust supply-side growth, reducing the risk premium on equities and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in expansion episodes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) falling below 100 indicates contracting supply-side activity, raising uncertainty and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d forward returns in contraction episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,500 for two consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns in expansion episodes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,200 for three consecutive months signals weak demand, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d forward returns in contraction episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
